grammar_decision: Set-equality repair (reviewer TASK-512: extensional universality). Hole = the defining predicate of the right-hand set (one linear equation in q.1, q.2), wrapped by the fixed part as imageLine = {q | onImageLine q}; universal obligation = the set equality (both inclusions); nonvacuity = a point of the corrected line off the claimed line; equivalent equations accepted semantically (kernel-checked equality + point tests), degenerate predicates rejected semantically, target capture rejected syntactically.

task.title: Image of the x-axis under a shear

located_defect.description: Stored proof-text line 0009 states that the x-axis Ox: y = 0 is transformed by the source's map L(x, y) = (x, x + y) (line 0002) into the line x + y = 0. As the set equality L '' XAxis = Claimed this is the located defect. Supply the defining equation of the actual image line and prove the set equality (both inclusions) for the source's fixed map; the record's endpoint is that corrected statement itself (the page's angle conclusion is not part of this record).

task.allowed_edit: Replace the hole in `onImageLine` by ONE linear equation in q.1 and q.2 with integer-literal coefficients (terms `c * q.i`, `q.i` and literals joined by + and -; mention q.1 or q.2; no ∧/∨/¬, quantifiers, membership, division or powers; do not mention L, XAxis or Claimed); nothing else in the fixed part may change. The map L, the axis XAxis and the set equality (both inclusions, not an inclusion) are fixed. Do not redefine L, XAxis, Claimed or SourceImageClaim; no instances, notations, macros, axioms or exports.
task.challenged_passage: 0009 the [[Definition:Axis/X-Axis|$x$-axis]] represented by the equation $Ox: y=0$ is transformed into $\LL (Ox) : x + y = 0$

notes: Grammar decision recorded in `grammar_decision`: predicate-of-the-right-hand-set hole with a set-equality universal obligation.
Endpoint = the set equality itself; the final role restates it (validate.py needs a final role for all_pass).
Nonvacuity is existential and leak-free (a point of the corrected line off the claimed line); the witness image (1, 1) lives only in AGREE.lean.
The hidden agreement is fail-closed: a predicate whose membership norm_num cannot decide at a listed point (e.g. m7's image membership) fails.
Names without apostrophes throughout (validate.py's #print axioms parser).
